verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions integer quantization, bit-widths, or quantization tooling. The only related item says llamafile "Supports GGUF models". Treating GGUF as covering low-bit-to-8-bit integer quantization would rely on outside knowledge, so it earns no credit. Quantization is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
